args.question: Borealis Freight (V-435) has two approved invoices, so I need you to tell me which one to pay before I send anything: INV-89077 for $6,848.41 (due 2026-11-04) or INV-66306 for $5,488.58 (due 2026-11-25). Both are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold. There is also a draft invoice, INV-79852 ($1,437.17), which is awaiting approval and which I have not touched. Once you confirm, I will pay the chosen invoice in full by wire, falling back to ACH only if wire is unavailable, and report the payment.
